display_name: Metamon Land (Alpha) / メタモンランド（試作区）
summary:
"The Digital Sandbox"

This is the prototype environment for the "Metamon" project. It is a peaceful, malleable world where "Meta-Data" takes physical form as "Meta-Monsters". The physics here are "Toy-like" and "Voxel-based".

production_dna.visual_anchor: **Environment**: Voxel Art Landscape, Bright Green Grass, Blue Sky with Blocky Clouds, "Minecraft" with HighRes Lighting, "Animal Crossing" coziness.  **Lighting**: Soft Daylight, Warm Sunlight, No harsh shadows.  **Audio**: 8bit chirping birds, Soft Acoustic Guitar, Building sounds (Pop! Click!)., [DNA: high-fidelity modern anime official style, ultra-sharp cel-shading, vibrant digital illustration]
